title: Moonlit Lake
blurb: A calm night lake where the moon shines twice. Collect moon pearls among ripples and reeds.

levels.name: Moonrise
levels.intro: Welcome to the lake. Collect the six moon pearls, the shining gems.

levels.name: Ripples
levels.intro: Break forty pegs in the spreading ripples. New: a multiball peg sends out two more balls.

levels.name: Lily Pads
levels.intro: Clear every peg from the lily pads. New: an extra ball peg gives you one more ball.

levels.name: Reed Bank
levels.intro: Break every orange cattail on top of the reeds. New: lightning lights the pegs nearby.

levels.name: Moon Phases
levels.intro: Reach the target score among the moons. New: a double points peg doubles that shot.

levels.name: Old Pier
levels.intro: Break the planks of the old pier. New: grey steel posts never break.

levels.name: Starlit Mirror
levels.intro: Make a chain of ten hits in one shot. New: a spray peg makes your next shot three balls.

levels.name: Rowboat
levels.intro: Light the lanterns on the boat and the water. New: springy bumpers bounce your ball away.

levels.name: Leaping Fish
levels.intro: Catch the silver fish gems as they leap. New: glass shatters at the first touch.

levels.name: Moon Bridge
levels.intro: Break thirty pegs around the moon bridge. New: portals send your ball to their twin.

levels.name: Lotus Bloom
levels.intro: Break every pink petal tip of the lotus. New: a safety net bounces your next ball back up.

levels.name: Night Rain
levels.intro: Clear every raindrop. The plate bounces in the rain. New: a fireball burns through pegs.

levels.name: Gentle Eddy
levels.intro: Make a chain of twelve in one shot. New: a blast peg makes your next ball burst on its first hit.

levels.name: Constellations
levels.intro: Join up the star pictures and reach the target score.

levels.name: Floating Lanterns
levels.intro: Light the floating lanterns as they drift. New: some pieces move, slowly.

levels.name: Moon Falls
levels.intro: Break all the glass and bricks of the moonlit waterfall.

levels.name: Pearl Shells
levels.intro: Hit a key to open the shell of the same colour, then collect every pearl. New: keys and gates.

levels.name: Mist Waves
levels.intro: Break forty-five pegs in the mist. New: the super guide shows a long aiming line.

levels.name: Moon Wheel
levels.intro: The moon wheel turns slowly. Break every yellow peg on its rim.

levels.name: Lake of Stars
levels.intro: The whole lake is shining. Collect every moon pearl, with powers all around to help.
